1

Connect on WhatsApp

Share your studio's project requirements—wedding films, reels, album design, or photo retouching—and get a clear scope, timeline, and transparent quote.

2

Place Your Project

Send your raw wedding footage or high-resolution photos via Google Drive or WeTransfer along with your reference style, music preferences, and editing brief.

3

Review & Final Delivery

Preview your drafts, share revision notes until you're 100% satisfied, and download client-ready 4K films, vertical reels, and print-ready album layouts.
